addition.item: Star ratings from 1 to 5 and text reviews by registered users of chosen groups, one review for each user and object.
Moderation: all new reviews, only those with a text, or none; links in reviews allowed, sent to moderation or forbidden; a daily limit for each user.
An email to the moderators when a review comes to wait for them, with a limit of emails per hour.
The block under Joomla articles in chosen categories and the shortcode {mucronixreviews}.
YOOtheme Pro: the element "Mucronix Reviews", the fields of the rating and the list of reviews in the dynamic content.
The rating and the reviews in the Schema.org markup that Joomla builds.
